question: Name the port that is privately owned by the Adani Group?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mundra Port, Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mundra Port** is located in the state of **Gujarat, India**.
 
• It is owned and operated by the **Adani Group**, a leading conglomerate in India.
 
• Mundra Port is the **largest private port** in India and one of the busiest ports in the country.
